text: {"rules":[{"id":"TOBACCO-PREVENT-YOUTH","version":"April 2020","title":"Primary care interventions to prevent tobacco use initiation in school-aged children and adolescents","source_quote":"The USPSTF recommends that primary care clinicians provide interventions, including education or brief counseling, to prevent initiation of tobacco use among school-aged children and adolescents.","grade":"B","effective_date":"2020-04","action":"Provide interventions, including education or brief counseling, to prevent initiation of tobacco use","denominator":"{\"all\": [{\"uncomputable\": {\"needs\": \"school-aged child or adolescent status (no numeric age range stated in section text)\"}, \"quote\": \"school-aged children and adolescents\"}, {\"uncomputable\": {\"needs\": \"lifetime tobacco use history confirming the patient has never started using any tobacco product\"}, \"quote\": \"who have not started to use tobacco\"}], \"quote\": \"school-aged children and adolescents who have not started to use tobacco\"}","numerator":"{\"uncomputable\": {\"needs\": \"documentation of tobacco-initiation prevention intervention (education or brief counseling); no interval stated\"}, \"quote\": \"provide interventions, including education or brief counseling, to prevent initiation of tobacco use\"}","exclusions":"[]"}],"coverage_notes":["The section gives no numeric age range for 'school-aged children and adolescents'; age is encoded as uncomputable rather than inventing bounds.","'Have not started to use tobacco' (never-use status) is encoded as uncomputable; the vocabulary concept tobacco_use (any/current use) and ever_smoker (smoking only) do not reliably capture never-use of all tobacco products.","No interval or frequency for the intervention is stated, so no measurement window was assigned; the numerator is uncomputable (prevention counseling/education is not a concept in the vocabulary and is not reliably held in structured EHR data).","The DATE field carries an asterisk ('April 2020 *') whose footnote is not included in the section text; its meaning could not be represented.","Specific intervention content, format, or intensity is not specified beyond 'education or brief counseling'."]}
